_comment: DOZEWOOD - a drowsy forest held at a long lilac dusk. A walk-and-nap world (no goal, no puzzle): mossy hollows, hammocks, hanging lamps of slow pale light, round trees and willows trailing their vines. Everything moves at half speed. Eight regions: Drowse Landing (where you arrive), Burrow Banks, Moss Hollows, Lullaby Water, Hammock Wood, Yawning Rise, Lampwick Reach and the Quiet End. It RE-SKINS ITSELF through its 'art' block (deep-merged over data/art.json): its own moss terrain + litter atlas, dusky trees (tree entries [x, y, kind]: round/oak/willow), a still dark pond, breathing lamp lights, a slow day cycle. Its secret is a place your companion dreams of: see the 'secret' block (reveal type 'dream'). Generated by tools/gen_dozewood_world.py (art: pokepals/tools/gen_dozewood.py) - edit that and re-run, don't hand-tune positions.
intro: Moss, and a lamp, and the light that never quite goes. Nothing here needs doing. Sit down; everything will wait.

props.label: a cushioned hollow
props.lore: A hollow in the moss, just the size of two, with a cushion someone left. It feels like a place where it's safe to close your eyes. Your companion might think so too, with a gentle pet and some quiet.

props.label: a cushioned hollow
props.lore: A round dip in the moss, warm as a bed that's just been left. Whatever sleeps here sleeps well.

props.label: a cushioned hollow
props.lore: A hollow between two roots, lined with soft lilac cloth. The moss around it has grown in a ring, to keep the draughts out.

props.label: a cushioned hollow
props.lore: A hollow at the foot of a lamp, where the light is slow and low. Even you feel a little drowsy, standing next to it.

props.label: a crooked arch
props.lore: An arch of old grey roots, grown crooked: one leg leans out, the top has slumped to the right. It frames nothing in particular, but the moss beneath it is a little brighter, as if something slept there.

props.label: a log with a lamp inside
props.lore: A hollow log, and a lamp glowing inside it, slow and pale. Somebody left it lit for whoever is sleeping in there. Nobody is.

props.label: a ring of toadstools
props.lore: Seven small toadstools, standing in a ring round a dip in the moss. Nothing is inside the ring but the quiet.

props.label: a sleeping boulder
props.lore: A boulder with a blanket of moss pulled up to its brow, and one eye shut. You would swear it was breathing. You decide not to wake it.

props.label: a smooth stone
props.lore: One of three smooth stones set round the pond. They are warm, which a stone shouldn't be.

props.label: a toadstool seat
props.lore: A flat-topped toadstool, exactly the right height for sitting. You sit. It is exactly right.

props.label: a hanging lamp
props.lore: A paper lamp on a crook of wood. Its light comes and goes about once a breath, if you breathe slowly.

props.label: a hammock
props.lore: A hammock slung between two posts. It's too small for you. It sways a little when you look at it, as if it knew.

props.label: a hammock
props.lore: A lilac hammock with a pillow already in it. The pillow has a dent in it, and the dent is still warm.

props.label: a mossy log
props.lore: A log so mossy it has become a sofa. Something small has been sleeping on it for a hundred years, on and off.

props.label: a stone with a name worn off
props.lore: Letters were cut here once. Moss has gently put them to bed.

_secret_comment: This world's one SECRET (docs/home-world-and-secrets-design.md, 'Dozewood'). reveal.type 'dream': the companion only dozes off in one of reveal.spots (nap spots) when it feels safe (a welcomed pet, you still and close, a calm mood; DreamGate), dreams of the landmark at reveal.landmark_position (picture: reveal.picture), and when you and it walk there together the prop rises (DozeDirector / SecretDirector). The server honours a claim only here, within 'radius' of 'position'.

secret.lore: A paper lantern, no bigger than a loaf, and its light comes and goes like a sleeper's breath. It isn't hot. It's the warmth of a bed that has just been left.

lines.hollow: Your companion sniffs the cushioned hollow and looks up at you. It would settle here, if it felt safe: a gentle pet, and a little quiet.
lines.calm: It's too wound up to settle. Stay still beside it a moment, and let it come down.
lines.settle: It turns round once, twice, and lies down, nose tucked in.
lines.yawn: It yawns, wide and slow. You feel it catch.
lines.asleep: Its breathing slows. It is asleep.
lines.dream: Soft bubbles rise from it. In the biggest, a place: a crooked arch of old roots, and a little brightness beneath it.
lines.wake_poked: It stirs at your call and blinks up at you. The dream drifts off, but not all the way.
lines.pet_asleep: It sighs in its sleep and tucks in closer under your hand. It sleeps on.
lines.wake_left: It wakes as you go, and gets up to follow, still half in the dream.
lines.yawn_ambient: Your companion yawns, huge and slow. You find you're yawning too.

reveal.reveal_line: Your companion stops short under the arch and looks about, as if it has been here before. A paper lantern is glowing on the moss.

secret.found_line: It dreamed of this place, and you walked there together. The lantern is lit by nothing but the dream, and it goes home with you.

keepsake.label: a dream-lantern on a cushion of moss
keepsake.line: A lantern that glows when it is dreamed of. Your companion curls up beside it, now and then, and goes to sleep.

portals.label: the way back to the Vale
